intro: Lesson 98. Plan a time-slip narrative set in 1588.

passage.title: The task
paras: Zara is exploring an old lookout tower on the south coast when the floor shakes and the air smells of smoke. When she looks out, the town below has changed: wooden ships crowd the harbour and men are lighting a beacon on the hill. It is 1588, and the Spanish Armada has been sighted.
Write the story of how Zara finds her way home. Show the past through her senses, include dialogue, and end with Zara back in the present, changed by what she saw.
